key_doctrine: California removes the federal oath requirement for prior inconsistent statements. ANY prior inconsistent statement — sworn or unsworn, formal or informal — is substantive evidence in California court under § 1235, provided the § 770 foundation (opportunity to explain or deny) is laid. This is California's single most powerful departure from federal evidence law for witness impeachment.
